issues.description: Method Farm.singFarmSongVerse: the problem statement UML declares singFarmSongVerse(animal: Animal): void as private (indicated by '-' in the UML) and the template implementation declares a private method signature (private void singFarmSongVerse(...)), but the solution implementation declares the method as protected (protected void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)). This visibility mismatch leaves students uncertain whether the helper method is intended to be internal to Farm only or accessible to subclasses, causing confusion about the intended API and test expectations.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility of Farm.singFarmSongVerse consistent across artifacts. Preferred fix: change the solution implementation signature to 'private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)' so it matches the UML and the template. Alternatively, if the method is intended to be available to subclasses, update the UML (and the template) to indicate protected visibility and document the rationale.
